notes.title: 📢 SnaPaul II - Now in Pre-Release! Add it to Your Wishlist!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We have exciting news—SnaPaul 2 is now available for pre-release on Steam! The nightmare is far from over, and this sequel will take fear to a whole new level.

🔦 Darker, more immersive horror
🏚️ Terrifying new environments
🎭 An unsettling story waiting to be uncovered

💀 Why add it to your wishlist?
By wishlisting SnaPaul II, you’ll be the first to know when it officially launches, and it helps us bring this game to as many horror fans as possible. Plus, it ensures you won’t miss out on any special announcements, updates, or exclusive content!

📌 Click the "Add to Wishlist" button now and get ready for the nightmare to continue!

notes.title: Update: General Improvements and Optimizations
notes.notes:
We've just released a new update for SnaPaul, focusing on improving the overall player experience! Here's what's new:

Improved performance in certain areas of the game.
Fixed minor bugs reported by the community.
Optimized lighting and textures for smoother gameplay.
General quality-of-life improvements.
Thank you for your support and feedback! We're committed to making SnaPaul even better. 

Let us know what you think about this update, and stay tuned for more!
